# LuxeStudio — Bespoke Website Building & Business Automation Agency

> Websites, digital systems, and automation for businesses that refuse to look ordinary.

LuxeStudio is an elite website building agency and creative technology studio that designs and engineers bespoke, high-performance websites, custom web applications, and intelligent business automation systems for ambitious brands, enterprises, and creators worldwide.

## Core Agency Capabilities

### 1. Bespoke Website Building & Engineering
Custom frontend and full-stack website building constructed from first principles. Unlike generic page builders or slow WordPress themes, LuxeStudio builds lean, lightning-fast web flagships engineered to rank top in search engines and convert visitors into high-paying clients.
- **Keywords / Expertise**: Bespoke website building, custom website development, luxury web design, high-performance website builder, JAMstack, Next.js, Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript, headless CMS (Sanity, Strapi), SEO & GEO optimization.
- **Key Benchmarks**: Sub-second First Contentful Paint (0.3s–0.8s), 95–100 Google Lighthouse scores, 100% Core Web Vitals, zero layout shifts, smooth 60fps animations.

### 2. Business Workflow Automation & Systems Integration
Automating repetitive back-office operations, connecting front-end customer touchpoints to CRM databases, and eliminating manual operational busywork.
- **Keywords / Expertise**: Business automation systems, workflow automation agency, website automation, CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho), WhatsApp Business API automations, automated lead routing, calendar booking workflows, webhook pipelines, Stripe/Razorpay automated invoicing.
- **Business Impact**: Instant response times to incoming leads, zero lost opportunities, automatic lead qualification, hands-off data reconciliation across disparate tools.

### 3. Interactive Web Experiences & 3D WebGL
Engaging brand interfaces with 3D spatial visuals, micro-interactions, and kinetic typography that command attention and drive brand prestige.
- **Specializations**: Three.js, WebGL shaders, GSAP motion choreography, Lenis smooth inertia, interactive canvases, custom cursor feedback.

### 4. Custom Web Applications & API Architecture
Full-stack web software, client portals, internal dashboards, and custom e-commerce storefronts tailored to unique operational demands.
- **Specializations**: Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, REST & GraphQL APIs, secure serverless cloud functions, custom database schemas.

- [Auri Concept](https://www.auriconcept.com/): Architectural Lighting & Smart Living Platform (Sion, Mumbai). Product catalog, magnetic track profiles, smart access systems, and WhatsApp consultation.

- [Cory Ryan Photography](https://coryryan.theluxestudio.in/): Editorial Photography Studio. Austin, Texas wedding & lifestyle photography portfolio with rich visual galleries.
- [Luxxe Labels](https://www.luxelabels.co.in/): Luxury Fashion & Designer Apparel E-Commerce Platform. High-aesthetic editorial lookbooks, fluid collection browsing, slide-out micro-cart, and automated WhatsApp VIP styling concierge.
- [The Face Craft Studio](https://luxestudio-live.github.io/r3-studio/pages/homepage.html): Professional Photography & Videography Studio Space Rental (Mumbai). Creative studio space booking, equipment matrix, lighting backdrops, and shoot scheduling.
- [Power Gold Gym](https://luxestudio-live.github.io/power-gold-gym/): Fitness & Athletic Training Platform. Membership tiers, personal trainer booking, and facility tours.
- [Vedant Hospital](https://luxestudio-live.github.io/vedant-hospital/): Multi-Specialty Hospital Portal (Bhandup West, Mumbai). Patient care navigation, specialist directory, and online OPD appointment booking.
- [Gravity Private Tutorials](https://www.gravityprivatetutorials.com/): Premier Academic Coaching Institute (Kandivali West, Mumbai). Course catalog, faculty profiles, and student enrollment portal.
- [Gurukul Study Center](https://gurukulstudycenter.in/): Educational Learning Center (Mumbai). Mathematics curriculum directory, academic counseling, and admissions interface.
- [Yogi's Yoga](https://www.yogisyoga.in/): Wellness & Mindfulness Studio. Class schedules, retreat registrations, and wellness programs.
- [Kamini Beautician & Makeup Academy](https://luxestudio-live.github.io/Kamini-Beautician-and-Makup-Academy/): Professional Aesthetics & Bridal Academy. Certified courses, portfolio gallery, and salon bookings.
- [Wellstead Pharmacy](https://wellstead-pharmacy.theluxestudio.in/): Community Healthcare & Clinical Dispensary (Surrey Hills, Melbourne VIC). Electronic prescriptions (eScripts), MedsCheck consults, Webster-pak® medication management, and NDSS diabetes care.
